<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] (MSF) suspends its operations in north-west [[Burkina Faso]] following the killings of two of its [[Humanitarian aid|aid worker]]s near [[Dédougou]]. Both those killed were [[Burkinabe nationality law|Burkinabe citizens]], according to MSF. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/02/09/msf-suspends-operations-in-northwest-burkina-faso-after-gunmen-kill-two-staff/ (Africa News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**The death toll from the earthquake in [[Turkey]] and [[Syria]] increases to 21,051. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230209-death-toll-tops-20-000-from-turkey-syria-quake-as-hopes-fade (AFP via RFI)]
*Four people are killed and several houses and buildings are destroyed during a 5.1 magnitude earthquake in [[Papua (province)|Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/2023/02/09/four-killed-buildings-damaged-as-earthquake-hits-eastern-indonesia (The Star)]
*Seven people are killed and nine others are injured in a [[gas explosion]] at a [[residential building]] in [[Novosibirsk]], [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-government-health-dedd86d97b6317069a0606c2a751e649 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**Three inmates are killed and 12 more injured after soldiers open fire during a [[prison riot]] in [[Hatay Province]], [[Turkey]]. The prisoners were demanding to see their families affected by the recent earthquake. [https://www.duvarenglish.com/three-inmates-killed-in-prison-riot-in-turkeys-quake-hit-hatay-news-61801 (Gazete Duvar)]
*The [[government of Nicaragua]] releases 222 [[political prisoner]]s and sends them to the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaragua-government-frees-more-than-200-political-prisoners-local-media-2023-02-09/ (Reuters)]
